To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the binding of the photoactive drug hypercin (Hyp) to the human, rat, or bovine serum albumin (HSA, RSA, BSA) is determined by the structural features of the protein binding site.

the differences in the structure of HSA, BSA, and RSA influence the binding properties of the Hyp, and the differences are related to the amino acid sequence and structure of the IIA subdomain of HSA, which differs from that of BSA and RSA.

the differences in the structures of the Hyp/HSA and the Hyp/RSA complexes compared with that of the Hyp/BSAs complex are related to the differences in the amino acid sequence of the IIA subdomain of HSA, BSA, and RSA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the amino acid composition and sequence of HSA, BSA, and RSA on their binding properties.
the binding properties of the photoactive natural product hypericin to human, rat, bovine, and recombinant human serum albumins.
a new approach to the study of the binding properties of the Hyp to serum albumins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the differences in the structure of the IIA subdomain in RSA and HSA are responsible for the differences observed in the binding properties.

the differences in the amino acid sequence of the IIA subdomain in HSA, BSA, and RSA, which are responsible for Hyp binding, are the major reason for the differences in the Hyp binding to the albumin proteins.
Hyp binds to HSA and RSA in a similar manner, but with different affinity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Hyp binds to HSA with higher affinity than RSA and BSA.
the Hyp/BSABinding properties of Hyp are determined by the structure of Hyp and by the structure of the binding site in the albumins.
Hyp binds to HSA, RSA and BSA in a similar manner but with different affinities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure of the binding site is more important than its sequence in determining the binding properties of a protein.
molecular modeling can be used as an effective tool for predicting the binding properties of drugs to proteins.
the binding properties of the albumins are determined not only by the amino acid sequence but also by the three-dimensional structure of the proteins.
